panEmbedUrl.description: Signed URL of the card processor's iframe that securely displays the PAN, CVV, and expiry to the cardholder. The full PAN and CVV never cross Grid's servers — render this URL in an iframe in your client to reveal card details. The URL is a short-lived bearer secret: render it immediately and never store, cache, or log it.

expiresAt.description: When the signed URL stops loading. Request a new reveal rather than re-rendering an expired URL.
